config.dataset: MNIST test split, excluded from base training
config.pools: Disjoint, equal tuned/reference sizes, balanced digits

metrics.raw_copy: Original FTSS repo copying rule at 1% and 5% calibration quantiles
metrics.visible_copy: Same rule after clipping generated pixels to [-1,1]
metrics.neighbor_preference: Generated sample closer to tuned than equal-size reference pool
metrics.membership: AUROC using negative MC flow loss, plus calibrated TPR/FPR
metrics.loss_gap: Reference mean flow loss minus tuned mean flow loss

config.ftss_protocol: Upstream finite differences with velocity [-10,10], states [-5,5]

analysis_protocol.predictor: -log(g_min/current pre-fine-tuning g_min); positive means increased contraction
analysis_protocol.secondary_predictor: Negative mean log FTSS curve ratio, averaged over all measured times
analysis_protocol.outcomes: Changes relative to the same trajectory at step zero
analysis_protocol.primary_replication: Upstream raw-pixel rule at 1% calibration quantile
analysis_protocol.strict_replication: Visible-image RMSE <= 0.05 or 0.10 in [0,1], nearer to tuned than reference
analysis_protocol.adjustment: Trajectory intercepts and common checkpoint-step effects, fitted within architecture
analysis_protocol.resampling: Seed blocks; repeated checkpoint measurements stay together
analysis_protocol.interpretation: Exploratory seed-block associations without causal claims or pooled-observation p-values
